help.en: We help old people in our community.
help.cn: 我们帮助社区里的老人。

help.en: Even a small act of kindness can help those in need.
help.cn: 即使是小小的善举也能帮助有需要的人。

charity.en: I gave money to a charity.
charity.cn: 我给了一家慈善机构钱。

charity.en: The charity helps children who have no home.
charity.cn: 这家慈善机构帮助没有家的孩子。

charity.en: She set up a charity to support disabled people in poor areas.
charity.cn: 她创办了一家慈善机构来支持贫困地区的残疾人。

donate.en: Many people donate clothes to the orphans.
donate.cn: 许多人把衣服捐给孤儿。

donate.en: If everyone donates a little, we can make a big difference together.
donate.cn: 如果每个人都捐一点，我们就能一起带来巨大的改变。

volunteer.en: The volunteers help clean the old people's homes.
volunteer.cn: 志愿者们帮忙打扫老人的家。

volunteer.en: As a volunteer, she spends every weekend caring for elderly people.
volunteer.cn: 作为一名志愿者，她每个周末都照顾年长的人。

community.en: I live in a small community.
Our community holds a charity show every year.
community.cn: 我们社区每年举办一场慈善义演。

community.en: A caring community always supports its weakest members.
community.cn: 一个有爱的社区总会支持它最弱小的成员。

elderly.cn: 这位年长的男士走得很慢。

elderly.en: We visit the elderly people in the nursing home.
elderly.cn: 我们去看望养老院里年长的人。

elderly.en: Volunteers offer warm company to the elderly who live alone.
elderly.cn: 志愿者为独居的老人提供温暖的陪伴。

disabled.en: He is disabled but very brave.
disabled.cn: 他身有残疾，但非常勇敢。

disabled.en: The school has special seats for disabled students.
disabled.cn: 学校为残疾学生设有专座。

disabled.en: With proper support, disabled people can live a full and active life.
disabled.cn: 有了适当的支持，残疾人也能过上充实而积极的生活。

orphan.en: The charity finds new homes for orphans.
orphan.cn: 这家慈善机构为孤儿寻找新家。

orphan.en: Many kind families are willing to adopt orphans and give them love.
orphan.cn: 许多善良的家庭愿意收养孤儿并给予他们爱。

poverty.en: Education can help people escape poverty.
poverty.cn: 教育能帮助人们摆脱贫困。

poverty.en: The charity works hard to end poverty in faraway villages.
poverty.cn: 这家慈善机构努力消除偏远村庄的贫困。

support.en: We support each other when life is hard.
support.cn: 生活艰难时我们彼此支持。

support.en: Your donation will support hundreds of families in need.
support.cn: 你的捐款将支持数百个有需要的家庭。

kind.en: It is kind of you to help the blind man.
kind.cn: 你帮助那位盲人真是太好了。

kind.en: A kind heart is the greatest gift one can give to others.
kind.cn: 一颗善良的心是一个人能给予他人的最好礼物。

caring.en: Caring people often volunteer to help others.
caring.cn: 有爱心的人常常自愿帮助他人。

caring.en: A caring teacher pays attention to every student's needs.
caring.cn: 一位有爱心的老师会关注每个学生的需要。

blind.en: The blind man uses a stick.
A guide dog helps the blind woman cross the road.
blind.cn: 一只导盲犬帮助这位盲人女士过马路。

blind.en: Although he is blind, he can read with his fingers.
blind.cn: 尽管他失明，他能用手指阅读。

deaf.en: Deaf people use sign language to talk.
We learned a few signs so we could chat with our deaf friend.
deaf.cn: 我们学了几个手势，这样就能和失聪的朋友聊天了。

difference.en: Your help can make a big difference.
difference.cn: 你的帮助能带来很大的改变。

difference.en: One person's kindness can make a real difference in someone's life.
difference.cn: 一个人的善意能给别人的生活带来真正的改变。

gesture.en: He made a gesture with his hand.
A friendly gesture can welcome a stranger.
gesture.cn: 一个友好的手势可以欢迎陌生人。

gesture.en: The same gesture may have different meanings in different cultures.
gesture.cn: 同样的手势在不同文化里可能有不同的含义。

signal.en: The red light is a signal to stop.
She gave a signal for us to be quiet.
signal.cn: 她给了个让我们安静的信号。

signal.en: Body language often sends signals that words cannot express.
signal.cn: 肢体语言常常传递出言语无法表达的信号。

smile.en: A smile can make people feel welcome.
smile.cn: 微笑能让人感到受欢迎。

smile.en: A warm smile is understood as friendliness all over the world.
smile.cn: 温暖的微笑在世界各地都被理解为友好。

frown.en: He frowned because he was confused.
frown.cn: 他皱起眉头，因为他困惑了。

frown.en: A frown often shows that someone is worried or unhappy.
frown.cn: 皱眉常常表示某人担忧或不开心。

nod.en: He nodded to show he agreed.
In many countries a nod means "yes", but not everywhere.
nod.cn: 在很多国家点头表示“是”，但并非处处如此。

shake.en: He shook his head to say no.
People shake hands to greet each other in many cultures.
shake.cn: 在很多文化里人们握手互相问候。

wave.en: We waved goodbye at the station.
A friendly wave is a simple way to say hello from far away.
wave.cn: 友好地挥挥手是远远打招呼的简单方式。

bow.en: In Japan people bow to show respect.
bow.cn: 在日本人们鞠躬以示尊敬。

bow.en: A deep bow can express thanks more strongly than words.
bow.cn: 深深的一躬比言语更能强烈地表达感谢。

hug.en: She gave her friend a warm hug.
hug.cn: 她给了朋友一个温暖的拥抱。

hug.en: A hug can comfort someone better than any words.
hug.cn: 拥抱比任何话语更能安慰一个人。

handshake.cn: 有力的握手显示出自信。

handshake.en: In business, a handshake is often the first form of greeting.
handshake.cn: 在商务场合，握手常常是第一种问候方式。

express.en: We express feelings with our faces and hands.
express.cn: 我们用面部和双手表达情感。

express.en: Body language helps us express what is hard to put into words.
express.cn: 肢体语言帮助我们表达难以言说的东西。

feeling.en: Her smile showed her happy feelings.
feeling.cn: 她的微笑流露出快乐的心情。

feeling.en: Sometimes a gesture shows our true feelings more clearly than words.
feeling.cn: 有时一个手势比言语更清楚地显示我们真实的感受。

polite.en: It is polite to say thank you.
A polite smile and a nod can make a good first impression.
polite.cn: 礼貌的微笑和点头能留下好的第一印象。

rude.en: Pointing at people is rude in some cultures.
rude.cn: 在某些文化里指着别人是不礼貌的。

rude.en: A gesture that is polite in one country may be rude in another.
rude.cn: 在一个国家礼貌的手势在另一个国家可能很无礼。

meaning.en: What's the meaning of this word?
The same sign can have different meanings.
meaning.cn: 同样的手势可以有不同的含义。

meaning.en: Understanding the meaning of body language helps avoid misunderstandings.
meaning.cn: 理解肢体语言的含义有助于避免误解。

traditional.en: Paper-cutting is a traditional Chinese skill.
traditional.cn: 剪纸是一门传统的中国技艺。

traditional.en: Many traditional skills are passed down from generation to generation.
traditional.cn: 许多传统技艺代代相传。

skill.cn: 烹饪是一项有用的技能。

skill.en: It takes years to learn this skill.
skill.cn: 学会这项技能需要很多年。

skill.en: Traditional skills like embroidery require great patience and practice.
skill.cn: 像刺绣这样的传统技艺需要极大的耐心和练习。

craft.en: This craft has a long history.
The old craft is in danger of disappearing without young learners.
craft.cn: 没有年轻学徒，这门古老手艺有消失的危险。

handmade.en: Handmade gifts are full of love.
Handmade crafts are often more valuable than machine-made ones.
handmade.cn: 手工制品往往比机器制造的更有价值。

culture.en: Festivals are an important part of our culture.
culture.cn: 节日是我们文化的重要部分。

culture.en: Traditional skills carry the culture of a country from the past.
culture.cn: 传统技艺承载着一个国家流传至今的文化。

heritage.cn: 这座庙宇是我们的遗产。

heritage.en: We must protect our cultural heritage.
heritage.cn: 我们必须保护我们的文化遗产。

heritage.en: Calligraphy is a precious part of China's cultural heritage.
heritage.cn: 书法是中国文化遗产中珍贵的一部分。

generation.en: My grandfather is from an older generation.
generation.cn: 我祖父来自更老的一代。

generation.en: This skill has lasted for many generations.
generation.cn: 这门技艺延续了好几代人。

generation.en: Each generation has a duty to pass down its traditions.
generation.cn: 每一代人都有责任传承自己的传统。

master.en: He is a kung fu master.
The master taught his apprentice carefully.
It takes decades to become a master of traditional embroidery.
master.cn: 成为传统刺绣大师需要数十年时间。

apprentice.en: The apprentice learns from the master every day.
A good apprentice will one day keep the craft alive.
apprentice.cn: 一个好学徒终有一天会让这门手艺延续下去。

knot.en: The Chinese knot is red and beautiful.
Making a Chinese knot is a traditional skill that needs careful hands.
knot.cn: 编中国结是一门需要灵巧双手的传统技艺。

embroidery.en: She learned embroidery from her grandmother.
Su embroidery is famous around the world for its fine detail.
embroidery.cn: 苏绣以其精细的细节闻名世界。

paper-cutting.en: Paper-cutting decorates our windows at Spring Festival.
paper-cutting.cn: 春节时剪纸装点着我们的窗户。

paper-cutting.en: Paper-cutting is a folk art that has been passed down for centuries.
paper-cutting.cn: 剪纸是一门流传了几百年的民间艺术。

calligraphy.en: We practice calligraphy with a brush.
Chinese calligraphy combines art and the beauty of written words.
calligraphy.cn: 中国书法把艺术与文字之美融为一体。

disappear.en: Some old crafts are slowly disappearing.
disappear.cn: 一些古老的手艺正在慢慢消失。

disappear.en: Without young learners, traditional skills may disappear forever.
disappear.cn: 没有年轻的学习者，传统技艺可能会永远消失。

pass down.en: Parents pass down skills to their children.
These crafts have been passed down through many generations.
pass down.cn: 这些手艺已经传承了许多代。

robot.en: The robot helps us clean the floor.
robot.cn: 机器人帮我们打扫地板。

robot.en: In the future, robots may do many of the jobs people do now.
robot.cn: 未来，机器人也许会做许多现在人类做的工作。

AI.en: AI can answer our questions quickly.
AI.cn: 人工智能能快速回答我们的问题。

AI.en: AI is changing the way we live, learn and work.
AI.cn: 人工智能正在改变我们生活、学习和工作的方式。

intelligent.en: This intelligent robot can learn by itself.
intelligent.cn: 这个智能机器人能自己学习。

intelligent.en: Intelligent machines can make decisions without human help.
intelligent.cn: 智能机器可以在没有人类帮助的情况下做决定。

control.en: We control the robot with a phone.
control.cn: 我们用手机控制机器人。

control.en: Scientists make sure humans can always control the machines they build.
control.cn: 科学家确保人类始终能控制他们制造的机器。

program.en: He programs the robot to dance.
program.cn: 他给机器人编程让它跳舞。

program.en: Engineers program robots to complete difficult and dangerous tasks.
program.cn: 工程师为机器人编程，让它们完成困难而危险的任务。

sensor.en: The robot uses sensors to avoid walls.
sensor.cn: 机器人用传感器避开墙壁。

sensor.en: Sensors help robots understand the world around them.
sensor.cn: 传感器帮助机器人理解周围的世界。

task.en: I have a task to do.
The robot finished the task quickly.
task.cn: 机器人很快完成了任务。

task.en: Robots can repeat the same task without ever getting tired.
task.cn: 机器人能重复同样的任务而永不疲倦。

factory.en: Robots work in this car factory.
factory.cn: 机器人在这家汽车工厂工作。

factory.en: Modern factories use robot arms to build products faster.
factory.cn: 现代工厂用机械臂更快地制造产品。

arm.en: The robot arm picks up the box.
A robot arm can lift heavy objects that no human could move.
arm.cn: 机械臂能举起人类无法搬动的重物。

industry.en: Robots are widely used in industry.
industry.cn: 机器人在工业中被广泛使用。

industry.en: AI is bringing huge changes to almost every industry.
industry.cn: 人工智能正给几乎每个行业带来巨大变化。

battery.en: The robot needs a new battery.
battery.cn: 机器人需要一块新电池。

battery.en: A longer-lasting battery lets the robot work all day.
battery.cn: 更耐用的电池让机器人能工作一整天。

human.en: Robots are made to help humans.
human.cn: 机器人被制造出来帮助人类。

human.en: No matter how smart robots become, humans must stay in charge.
human.cn: 无论机器人变得多聪明，人类都必须掌握主导权。

replace.en: Robots may replace people in dangerous jobs.
replace.cn: 机器人也许会在危险工作中取代人。

replace.en: Some people worry that robots will replace human workers one day.
replace.cn: 有些人担心机器人有一天会取代人类工人。

dream.en: His dream is to build a smart robot.
dream.cn: 他的梦想是造一个智能机器人。

dream.en: With hard work, a dream about the future can come true.
dream.cn: 只要努力，关于未来的梦想就能成真。

future.en: Robots will be common in the future.
In the future, machines and people may work side by side.
future.cn: 未来，机器和人也许会并肩工作。

endangered.cn: 我们必须保护濒危动物。

endangered.en: Many endangered species will be lost unless we act now.
endangered.cn: 除非我们现在行动，许多濒危物种将会消失。

extinct.en: Some animals became extinct long ago.
extinct.cn: 有些动物很久以前就灭绝了。

extinct.en: If we do nothing, the tiger may become extinct in the wild.
extinct.cn: 如果我们什么都不做，老虎也许会在野外灭绝。

tiger.cn: 老虎正在失去它们的家园。

tiger.en: Fewer than four thousand wild tigers are left on Earth.
tiger.cn: 地球上仅剩不到四千只野生老虎。

elephant.en: Elephants are hunted for their ivory.
We must stop the hunting that threatens elephants with extinction.
elephant.cn: 我们必须制止使大象濒临灭绝的猎杀。

whale.en: Whales live in the deep sea.
Pollution in the ocean puts many whales in great danger.
whale.cn: 海洋污染让许多鲸面临巨大危险。

habitat.en: Animals lose their habitat when forests are cut down.
habitat.cn: 森林被砍伐时动物失去栖息地。

habitat.en: Protecting habitats is the best way to save endangered animals.
habitat.cn: 保护栖息地是拯救濒危动物的最好办法。

reserve.en: Pandas are safe in the reserve.
reserve.cn: 熊猫在保护区里很安全。

reserve.en: Nature reserves give wild animals a safe place to live.
reserve.cn: 自然保护区给野生动物一个安全的生活之所。

hunting.en: Hunting for fur and ivory has made many animals endangered.
hunting.cn: 为获取毛皮和象牙的猎杀使许多动物濒危。

poacher.en: Rangers work day and night to stop poachers in the reserve.
poacher.cn: 护林员日夜工作以阻止保护区里的偷猎者。

ivory.en: Buying ivory is against the law.
If no one buys ivory, poachers will stop killing elephants.
ivory.cn: 如果没人买象牙，偷猎者就会停止猎杀大象。

research.en: Research helps us understand wild animals.
research.cn: 研究帮助我们了解野生动物。

research.en: Scientists' research shows how to protect endangered species better.
research.cn: 科学家的研究告诉我们如何更好地保护濒危物种。

donation.cn: 捐款帮助拯救濒危动物。

donation.en: Your donation pays for food and care in the animal reserve.
donation.cn: 你的捐款支付了动物保护区里的食物和照料。

survive.en: Few baby turtles survive in the wild.
survive.cn: 野外很少有小海龟能存活。

survive.en: Without our help, these animals cannot survive much longer.
survive.cn: 没有我们的帮助，这些动物活不了多久。

population.en: Thanks to protection, the panda population is slowly growing again.
population.cn: 得益于保护，熊猫的数量正在慢慢回升。

awareness.en: The poster raises awareness about animals.
awareness.cn: 这张海报提高了人们对动物的意识。

awareness.en: Raising awareness is the first step to saving endangered animals.
awareness.cn: 提高意识是拯救濒危动物的第一步。

plant.en: Green plants give us fresh air.
plant.cn: 绿色植物给我们新鲜空气。

plant.en: Plants turn sunlight into the energy that all life depends on.
plant.cn: 植物把阳光变成所有生命赖以生存的能量。

seed.en: Plant the seed in the soil.
The seed grows into a small plant.
A tiny seed can one day grow into a tall tree.
seed.cn: 一粒小小的种子有一天能长成参天大树。

soil.en: Plants need good soil to grow.
soil.cn: 植物需要好的土壤才能生长。

soil.en: Rich soil gives plants the food they need to grow strong.
soil.cn: 肥沃的土壤给植物生长壮大所需的养分。

sunlight.en: The flowers turn towards the sunlight.
Without enough sunlight, most plants cannot make their food.
sunlight.cn: 没有足够的阳光，大多数植物无法制造养分。

grow.en: With water and sunlight, the seed will grow into a healthy plant.
grow.cn: 有了水和阳光，种子会长成一株健康的植物。

bloom.en: When the warm days come, the whole garden begins to bloom.
bloom.cn: 温暖的日子来临时，整个花园开始绽放。

root.en: The root is in the soil.
Roots take in water for the plant.
Strong roots hold the plant firmly in the ground.
root.cn: 强壮的根把植物牢牢固定在地里。

stem.en: Water moves up through the stem.
The stem carries water and food between the roots and leaves.
stem.cn: 茎在根和叶之间运送水分和养分。

species.en: There are many plant species in the forest.
species.cn: 森林里有许多植物物种。

species.en: Some rare plant species grow only in one part of the world.
species.cn: 一些稀有植物物种只生长在世界的某一处。

rare.en: Rare plants are protected by law.
Botanists travel far to study rare plants in the mountains.
rare.cn: 植物学家长途跋涉去研究山中的稀有植物。

botanist.en: The botanist found a new flower.
botanist.cn: 这位植物学家发现了一种新花。

botanist.en: Botanists work hard to protect plants that may disappear.
botanist.cn: 植物学家努力保护可能消失的植物。

medicine.en: I take medicine when I'm ill.
Some plants are used to make medicine.
Many modern medicines come from plants found in the rainforest.
medicine.cn: 许多现代药物来自雨林中发现的植物。

garden.en: She grows roses in her garden.
A botanical garden keeps thousands of different plant species.
garden.cn: 植物园里养着成千上万种不同的植物。

ecosystem.en: Plants are important to the ecosystem.
ecosystem.cn: 植物对生态系统很重要。

ecosystem.en: Losing one species can harm the whole ecosystem.
ecosystem.cn: 失去一个物种可能危害整个生态系统。

oxygen.en: Forests produce much of the oxygen that living things need.
oxygen.cn: 森林产生了生物所需的大部分氧气。

moon.en: The moon goes around the Earth.
Humans first walked on the moon in 1969.
moon.cn: 人类于1969年首次登上月球。

Earth.en: The Earth travels around the sun.
From space, the Earth looks like a beautiful blue ball.
Earth.cn: 从太空看，地球像一个美丽的蓝色球体。

orbit.en: The spacecraft entered the moon's orbit.
orbit.cn: 航天器进入了月球轨道。

orbit.en: The satellite stays in orbit while it circles the Earth.
orbit.cn: 卫星在绕地球运行时保持在轨道上。

gravity.en: The moon has less gravity than the Earth.
Because of low gravity, astronauts can jump very high on the moon.
gravity.cn: 由于引力小，宇航员在月球上能跳得很高。

rocket.en: The rocket flew into the sky.
A powerful rocket is needed to carry a spacecraft into space.
rocket.cn: 需要强大的火箭才能把航天器送入太空。

astronaut.en: The astronaut walked on the moon.
Astronauts train for years before they fly into space.
astronaut.cn: 宇航员要训练多年才能飞入太空。

spacecraft.en: The spacecraft landed on the moon.
The spacecraft sent back amazing pictures of the moon's surface.
spacecraft.cn: 航天器传回了月球表面的惊人照片。

surface.en: The moon's surface is covered with dust.
There are many craters on the rocky surface of the moon.
surface.cn: 月球岩石表面有许多陨石坑。

crater.en: Each crater was made by a rock crashing into the moon.
crater.cn: 每个陨石坑都是岩石撞击月球形成的。

dark side.en: We can't see the dark side.
The dark side of the moon always faces away from us.
dark side.cn: 月球背面总是背对着我们。

dark side.en: China's spacecraft was the first to land on the dark side of the moon.
dark side.cn: 中国的航天器是首个登陆月球背面的。

launch.en: The rocket was launched at night.
Thousands of people watched the launch of the moon mission.
launch.cn: 成千上万的人观看了登月任务的发射。

explore.en: Scientists explore the moon with robots.
explore.cn: 科学家用机器人探索月球。

explore.en: People have always dreamed of exploring distant planets.
explore.cn: 人类一直梦想着探索遥远的行星。

mission.en: The space mission lasted many days.
mission.cn: 这次太空任务持续了很多天。

mission.en: The mission's goal was to bring moon rocks back to Earth.
mission.cn: 这次任务的目标是把月球岩石带回地球。

Chang'e.cn: 嫦娥是一个月球探测器。

Chang'e.en: Chang'e landed safely on the moon.
Chang'e.cn: 嫦娥安全地降落在月球上。

Chang'e.en: The Chang'e probe brought moon soil back to China.
Chang'e.cn: 嫦娥探测器把月壤带回了中国。

green.en: We should live a green life.
green.cn: 我们应该过环保的生活。

green.en: Going green means protecting the environment in our daily life.
green.cn: 践行环保意味着在日常生活中保护环境。

environment.en: A clean environment makes us healthy.
environment.cn: 干净的环境使我们健康。

environment.en: Everyone has a duty to keep the environment clean and safe.
environment.cn: 每个人都有责任让环境保持洁净与安全。

pollution.en: We can reduce pollution by using buses and bikes more often.
pollution.cn: 我们可以多乘公交、多骑车来减少污染。

climate.cn: 气候变化让科学家担忧。

climate.en: Cutting carbon helps slow down dangerous climate change.
climate.cn: 减少碳排放有助于减缓危险的气候变化。

warming.cn: 全球变暖是真实存在的。

warming.en: Global warming is caused mainly by burning too much coal and oil.
warming.cn: 全球变暖主要是由燃烧过多的煤和石油造成的。

recycle.en: Recycling waste saves energy and protects natural resources.
recycle.cn: 回收废物节约能源并保护自然资源。

reuse.en: We can reuse old bottles for water.
reuse.cn: 我们可以重复使用旧瓶子装水。

reuse.en: Reusing things instead of throwing them away cuts down on rubbish.
reuse.cn: 重复使用物品而非丢弃可以减少垃圾。

reduce.en: We should reduce the use of plastic.
reduce.cn: 我们应该减少塑料的使用。

reduce.en: Reduce, reuse and recycle are the three keys to a green life.
reduce.cn: 减少、重复使用和回收是环保生活的三大要点。

plastic.en: We should say no to plastic bags and carry cloth ones instead.
plastic.cn: 我们应该拒绝塑料袋，改用布袋。

rubbish.en: Don't throw rubbish on the ground.
Sorting rubbish makes it easier to recycle and reuse.
rubbish.cn: 垃圾分类让回收和再利用更容易。

sort.en: We sort rubbish into different bins.
sort.cn: 我们把垃圾分到不同的桶里。

sort.en: Learning to sort waste correctly is good for the environment.
sort.cn: 学会正确地给垃圾分类有益于环境。

carbon.en: We should cut carbon to protect the air.
carbon.cn: 我们应该减碳以保护空气。

carbon.en: Using clean energy helps lower the amount of carbon we produce.
carbon.cn: 使用清洁能源有助于降低我们产生的碳量。

footprint.en: We can lower our carbon footprint.
Walking instead of driving reduces your carbon footprint.
footprint.cn: 步行代替开车能减少你的碳足迹。

renewable.en: Renewable energy from the sun and wind will never run out.
renewable.cn: 来自太阳和风的可再生能源永不枯竭。

responsibility.cn: 保护自然是每个人的责任。

responsibility.en: We all share the responsibility of building a greener world.
responsibility.cn: 我们都肩负着建设更绿色世界的责任。
